highlights.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
highlights.description: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

highlights.title: Arrested OpenAI Engineer Seeks Bail, Denies Planning to Flee
highlights.description: The OpenAI software engineer charged with using a hidden recording device in one of the company’s offices asked to be freed from custody and denied his purchase of a one-way plane ticket to his native Saudi Arabia was part of a plan to flee US justice.

highlights.title: Amazon wants you to Bee-lieve wearable AI can recall it all for you
highlights.description: Would you like personalized shopping recommendations based on that conversation you just had?

highlights.title: The Tesla Roadster should go into production in 2028, but don't get your hopes up
highlights.description: I drive upside down on the boulevard of broken dreams.

highlights.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
highlights.description: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

highlights.title: Some companies give AI to everyone. This CEO is doing the opposite
highlights.description: Paysend CEO Ben Chisell limits AI tools to top performers as other U.K. companies push broader workplace rollouts.

highlights.title: US Army to use 3D-printed rocket motors for low-cost cruise missiles
highlights.description: X-Bow Systems has been tapped to 3D-print rocket motors for the U.S. Army's low-cost cruise missiles.
